items.name: Gấu Trúc Ký Ức
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone production profile avatar sprite for Memory Match Adventure.
Primary request: an adorable red panda librarian with rich auburn fur, expressive warm eyes and a pressed-leaf bookmark tucked into a little blank green book; glowing mossy storybook forest library inside the circular portrait.
Style: rich polished storybook fantasy collectible game art, finely painted dimensional materials, elegant warm gold highlights, deep blue shadows, expressive charming subject where applicable. Match the established premium storybook animal portraits and ornamented frames; distinct new artwork, no copied existing character.
Composition: square canvas. One round opaque portrait disk centered precisely on square. Circle diameter about78% of canvas; outside circle genuinely transparent alpha. Entire subject, ears, horns, crown and scene strictly inside the circular disk. Smooth filled circular edge. No frame, ring, loose particles or protrusions. This avatar will fit under a separate overlay frame.
Critical: genuine RGBA transparency, not painted checkerboard. ONE item only, no sheet, comparison, UI, text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. All ornament tips complete, no cropping.
